policy: Deterministic in-game benchmark viewpoints tied to lawful visual references. Camera coordinates are benchmark camera placements only unless a source explicitly publishes the camera location. Published source coordinates are recorded as source metadata and must not be upgraded to survey-grade accuracy without independent evidence. UrbIS/LiDAR remain authoritative for city geometry and terrain.

views.subject: Atomium ground-level oblique silhouette
views.camera_claim: The Wikimedia Commons source explicitly publishes a camera location at 50.897467 N, 4.339306 E. This is preserved as source-provided camera metadata, not promoted to survey-grade accuracy. Official phase-1 UrbIS DTM sampling resolves the vertical placement and a deterministic 1280x720 in-game capture is now registered. Benchmark promotion remains blocked by unresolved framing/lens and foreground/material mismatches.
views.coordinate_transform: WGS84 EPSG:4326 to Belgian Lambert 72 EPSG:31370; project X=east-originE, Z=-(north-originN)

subject_geometry.role: registered official Atomium height used only to audit apparent framing at the source-geolocated camera

terrain_elevation_evidence.method: four-corner bilinear interpolation of valid 5 m UrbIS DTM runtime samples; no extrapolation or NoData substitution

framing_geometry_evidence.meaning: At the current 50 degree benchmark FOV, registered geometry predicts that the full 102 m subject occupies only about 35.45% of capture height. This proves the current framing is wide relative to the monument geometry, but does not by itself determine the source lens.

views.candidate_audit_role: historical safety audit only; superseded for camera-position selection because the source page publishes camera coordinates and the published point lies outside the previous 60-220 m candidate radius

must_resolve: reference-image Atomium bounding-box measurement before changing FOV; geometry-only audit must not be presented as recovered lens metadata
hero-visible fountain/open-space, vegetation and furniture context from authoritative or lawful sources
material/detail mismatch review before any realism-complete claim
must_not_infer: survey-grade precision beyond the source-published camera metadata
lens focal length from visual intuition or geometry-only projection alone
street or path geometry absent from authoritative data
remaining_unknowns: exact yaw and pitch after accounting for image crop
